mappings.note: Asks for the poem's main message - LO-53's 'identify main ideas'. Rejected LO-54, which is for questions needing inference past the stated idea.

Cloze summary of the poem: choosing between highlighted alternatives only works if the pupil has grasped the poem's content, so LO-53's main ideas. Rejected LO-58 (writing to dictation) - nothing is dictated, and rejected LO-59, as the pairs are content choices, not synonyms.
The wish is stated in the opening lines. LO-53 detail retrieval.
'Friends should be loving' is the poem's own claim; LO-53's main idea rather than LO-54.
Asks the pupil to justify calling the poem a prayer - a claim about the whole text that it never makes. LO-54 over LO-53.
'Blessed' is the poem's own word for the feeling. LO-53 detail retrieval.
Asks what one word contributes to the theme - an interpretive judgement, LO-54. Rejected LO-59: the word 'best' is not being glossed, its effect is being weighed.
The speaker's reason for wanting to do more is never given; inference, so LO-54 not LO-53.
What she wants beyond sharing is stated in the lines. LO-53.
Names the form ('a prayer') from the title and content - recognising the text's overall idea, LO-53. Rejected LO-50, which is about reciting poems, not naming a form.
'How can we say so' demands evidence for an inference about what the speaker knows; LO-54 over LO-53.
How she aims to help is stated. LO-53 detail retrieval.
Infers a character trait ('thoughtful') from two quoted lines; the trait is nowhere named, so LO-54.

'Do you also pray for your friend? What do you wish for?' turns the poem onto the pupil's own life - LO-53 closes with 'relate them to personal experience'. Rejected LO-49 (group discussion) because the bank scores this as a written 3-mark answer.
The refusal to judge is stated in the poem. LO-53.
True/false against what the poem actually asks for. LO-53 detail verification.

A listening-comprehension item: the pupil hears a talk (NCERT p.72 transcript) and answers in one or two words. Cited at competency level because C-ENG1.2's two outcomes cover oral MESSAGES/telephone calls (LO-51) and announcements/instructions (LO-52) - neither reaches a listening passage - so the competency is the honest ceiling in this 16-outcome frame. Rejected LO-53, which is reading.
The poem says 'blessed' but never says why; the reason must be inferred. LO-54 over LO-53.
True/false on a stated wish. LO-53.
Unpacks 'much more than share' into what it implies about the friendship - interpretation, LO-54. Rejected LO-59: the pupil is not deducing an unknown word's meaning but the line's import.
True/false on acceptance, which the poem states outright. LO-53.
The kind of effort promised is stated. LO-53 detail retrieval.
True/false on an idea the poem contradicts; detail verification, LO-53.

Central theme - LO-53's main idea, plainly.
